environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF association. ALB access logs enabled to S3 but no real-time analysis. The application process runs as 'appuser' with read/write access to the SQLite database. CloudWatch basic monitoring only.
